author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text: My time saved from using AI is 100% reinvested into learning more about AI.  That's how you compound your growth and learning.

reshared_post.author_headline: CEO @ Section  |  New essays every week @ supercompanies.substack.com
reshared_post.reshared_text:
Of course there’s ROI in AI - but the employee is keeping it.

75% of the C-suite says AI hasn’t meaningfully affected costs. 84% of employees say AI is saving them time. Hmm… something doesn’t add up there.

The obvious answer - employees are using AI, getting things done faster, then using the extra time to run errands or take the afternoon off.

They’re not being lazy. They just have no incentive to show the boss how much time they’re saving. As soon as they say they’re saving 4 hours a week, the CEO will think, “Great! Time for a layoff.”

Leaders: These people aren’t slackers. They’re AI champions. You need to incentivize them to raise their hands, then reward them and learn from them (not lay them off).

And look for the small percentage of people who are ambitious enough to replace their free time with more output. Those are your future leaders.
